title: 05.06 - Seeing other peoples answers after contributing
intent: Explain whether participants can see other contributions or published results after submitting.
short_answer: It depends on the survey settings. If you do not see a link to published results after submitting your contribution, this feature may not be available for that survey.
procedure: Check whether the Confirmation page or survey page provides a link to published results.
If no link is available and you believe the results should be public, contact the survey author.
important_conditions: The possibility to see other answers is controlled by the survey settings.
Published results may not be available for all surveys.
related_articles: 02.01 - How to contact the survey owner
